patches.title: Common-Sense Source Prioritization
patches.principle: First go to the surface or container that most likely holds the target object based on typical room layouts.
patches.when_to_apply: When the target object is not yet located and a plausible container is known.

patches.title: Direct Post-Acquisition Placement
patches.principle: After picking up the target object, go directly to the destination and place it without any intermediate actions.
patches.when_to_apply: Immediately after successfully picking up the target object.
